title: KYE Capability Manifest
description: Declarative manifest registered for every capability (skill, tool, MCP tool, function, connector, prompt, workflow, playbook, runbook, model_profile, payment_action, api_operation). Drives runtime PDP gating, EU AI Act risk classification, supply-chain attestation, and dependency resolution. Companion to capability.json (the registration record). When capability_kind=skill this IS the Skill Authority Manifest: the SKILL.md description of how an agent acts, bound to whether the agent was allowed to act (purpose_binding_ref, finality_boundary, evidence_requirement, revocation).

risk_classification.description: EU AI Act Title II classification when ai_system_id is bound.

purpose_binding_ref.description: Reference to the §12 Purpose Permission™ purpose-scope grant this capability runs under. The capability may act only for the bound purpose; an out-of-purpose invocation is refused at the PDP boundary. Resolves to a kye.purpose.request.v1 / purpose-grant identifier.

finality_boundary.description: Authority Finality™ ceiling — the most consequential outcome this capability is permitted to reach. A skill that may only draft cannot commit; a skill that may only recommend cannot submit externally. Anything above the boundary is refused.

evidence_requirement.description: What MUST seal into the §13 Evidence Pack™ for each consequential invocation of this capability, so the action is replay-verifiable from public keys alone.

sealed_fields.description: Field names that MUST be captured into the Evidence Pack (e.g. tool_calls, mcp_servers_called, scope_touched, decision_code, finality_reached).

replay_verifiable.description: Whether the sealed pack must be re-verifiable offline from the published key set.

revocation.description: Time-bound and suspendable authority — every grant carries an end, never an open-ended licence. Drives expiry sweeps and incident-time suspension with finality.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry; after this instant the capability is refused until re-granted.

suspendable.description: Whether the capability can be suspended out-of-band (e.g. on compromise) before expiry.
